labs.title: Azure Operations
labs.summary: Build an Azure operations agent: connect code and knowledge, investigate telemetry and incidents, remediate autonomously and review cost.

challenges.title: Prerequisites & Lab Setup
challenges.summary: Deploy the workloads with Terraform, create your Azure SRE Agent, and generate baseline traffic. Add the agent's capabilities in Challenges 01–06.

challenges.title: Connect Your Codebase
challenges.summary: Connect GitHub and link your repository. Verify that the agent can read source code and use GitHub actions within the configured scope.

challenges.title: Explore the Knowledge Base
challenges.summary: Add lab knowledge documents, then compare the agent's answers before and after upload. Check resource details and citations.

challenges.title: Discover Operational Skills
challenges.summary: Add the supplied skills so the agent can run KQL queries, inspect Container App health, and follow operational runbooks. Test its tool and approval boundaries.

challenges.title: Discover Connected Systems
challenges.summary: Connect Microsoft Learn through MCP so the agent can retrieve current Azure documentation. Verify its citations.

challenges.title: Discover Specialist Agents
challenges.summary: Add domain-specific subagents with their own instructions, tools, and runbooks. Compare their investigation plans with the main agent's.

challenges.title: Understand Response Plans
challenges.summary: Connect Azure Monitor and configure response plans. Compare an unmatched alert with one that starts an investigation, then inspect Review and Autonomous modes.

challenges.title: Hybrid Ecosystem Telemetry
challenges.summary: The Parking Manager spans Container Apps, VMs, and a third-party OpenTelemetry API. Use the agent to query all three platforms and produce a unified cross-system view.

challenges.title: Application Dependency Mapping
challenges.summary: Map Grubify dependencies from Application Insights, including call counts and response times. Add Berlin Parking API metrics as a separate telemetry source.

challenges.title: Daily Application Health Report
challenges.summary: Ask the agent to generate a structured health report for all four Parking Manager APIs — CPU, memory, error rate, response time — with a health score and recommended remediation for any service falling below threshold.

challenges.title: Incident to GitHub Issue
challenges.summary: Trigger a Parking Manager incident and have the agent create or update a GitHub issue with evidence, a timeline, and next steps. This workflow reports the incident; it does not restart a VM.

challenges.title: Guest OS Failure Investigation
challenges.summary: Stop NGINX on the web-tier VMs. Watch the agent find the failure in Syslog, assess the blast radius across both VMs, and restore the service on every affected instance.

challenges.title: Network Security Investigation
challenges.summary: Inject an NSG rule that blocks database traffic. Check whether the agent traces denied flows to the rule, removes it, and verifies recovery.

challenges.title: Routing Failure Investigation
challenges.summary: Introduce an asymmetric routing black hole where return packets never arrive. Work with the network-traffic-analyst over effective routes and next-hop analysis to find and fix the return path.

challenges.title: Application Root Cause Analysis
challenges.summary: Trace a Grubify 5xx spike through container logs, Application Insights, and source code to the OOM fault path. Review the GitHub issue linking evidence to code.

challenges.title: Autonomous Remediation
challenges.summary: Stop the Paris Parking API service. Check whether the agent restarts the VM, validates service and API health, and retries or escalates if recovery fails.

challenges.title: Daily Network Health Report
challenges.summary: Create a scheduled task that reviews 24 hours of network telemetry every morning and produces a decision-ready summary: denied flows, top talkers, missing VNet coverage, and unusual ports.

challenges.title: Observability Freshness Verification
challenges.summary: Check VNet Flow Log freshness in Storage and Traffic Analytics. Compare expected VNet coverage with recent records to find missing or stale telemetry.

challenges.title: Subscription Cost Optimization Review
challenges.summary: Review inventory, spend, utilization, and Azure Advisor findings. Rank savings opportunities against workload criticality and SLAs without changing resources.

challenges.title: Build Your Own Production-Ready SRE Agent
challenges.summary: Bring a real reliability problem, build a focused agent configuration, and demonstrate an end-to-end test. Explain the controls and validation needed before production use.

labs.title: SQL Server DBA
labs.summary: Connect a read-only SQL Server specialist through a hardened MCP server and investigate Query Store, waits, blocking and query performance without changing the database.

challenges.title: Deploy the Read-Only DBA Path
challenges.summary: Deploy the supplied .NET MCP container, map its managed identity into the least-privilege observer role, secure the Streamable HTTP endpoint, and prove that Azure SRE Agent can inspect SQL without receiving a write path.

challenges.title: Orient to the Database
challenges.summary: Turn catalog metadata into a business map while keeping declared relationships separate from inferred domain meaning.

challenges.title: Establish a Query Store Baseline
challenges.summary: Seed repeatable activity and define a trustworthy historical observation window before diagnosing regressions.

challenges.title: Separate Duration from Pressure
challenges.summary: Observe a long-running wait and prevent elapsed time from becoming a false performance diagnosis.

challenges.title: Trace a Blocking Chain
challenges.summary: Identify the head blocker, blocked request, wait resource, and transaction age without terminating either session.

challenges.title: Build an Evidence-Based Index Case
challenges.summary: Correlate Query Store, the existing index set, and an estimated plan before recommending a change.

challenges.title: Diagnose Query Shape Problems
challenges.summary: Find non-SARGable predicates and implicit conversions, then explain their access-path impact without rewriting production code.

challenges.title: Investigate Parameter Sensitivity
challenges.summary: Compare skewed parameter populations, plan history, and runtime distributions before claiming parameter sensitivity.

challenges.title: Triage a Combined Database Incident
challenges.summary: Correlate concurrent signals, rank findings by demonstrated impact, preserve alternative explanations, and deliver a decision-ready read-only handoff.

challenges.title: Build Your Own SQL Server DBA Agent
challenges.summary: Design and validate a focused read-only investigation workflow for a database reliability question of your choosing.
